thread:
Sam: kicking off staggered rollout v2.14.0 -> eu1 (30%) at 2026-03-21T09:20Z. watching synthetic probes and kv-prefill.

deploy-bot: deploy v2.14.0 service=inference-proxy region=eu1 stage=canary percent=30 status=IN_PROGRESS

Maria: synth-embed probe failed in eu1 immediately, p95 jumped. grabbing traces. :warning:

deploy-bot: smoke-check synth-embed-eu1 result=FAIL metrics={p50:0.41s,p95:3.05s,error_rate:5.1%} threshold_p95=0.8s

Jordan: are these 503s or client timeouts?

Maria: mostly 503 from upstream model-serving. sample: ```
[2026-03-21T09:22:01Z] inference-proxy eu1 - upstream_status=503 upstream_service=model-serving exec=88ms - "POST /v1/embeddings"
[2026-03-21T09:22:01Z] kv-cache miss prefix="user:prefill"
```

Derek: exec=88ms with 503 implies container rejected request. check OOMs/gpu memory. Any quant/kernel changes?

Sam: v2.14.0 had a routing tweak for embed variants and a tokenizer fix. routing could pick a higher-memory variant.

Maria: model-serving logs show OOM kills and restarts on ~3/10 canary pods, correlated with a specific subset.

Ryan: oncall here. I'll route eu1 embed traffic back to v2.13.9 while you triage. prefer region pin over global rollback.

Sam: agree. hold rollout and pin eu1 embed to v2.13.9 until we diagnose.

Derek: plan: pause global rollout, apply region-specific pin to 100% v2.13.9 for embed in eu1, continue triage, prepare hotfix if needed. create incident and post release note.

Maria: +1. hotfix candidate would revert routing change in v2.14.1; pin minimizes blast radius.

deploy-bot: ACTION: hold rollout for v2.14.0 (eu1). Suggested command: ```
redwoodctl route update --service inference-proxy --region eu1 --route embed --pin-version v2.13.9 --reason "postdeploy synth failures"
```

Sam: applying pin now. will confirm.

Sam: done. deploy-bot: verify traffic split.

deploy-bot: route update applied service=inference-proxy region=eu1 route=embed pinned_version=v2.13.9 status=OK

Maria: re-running synth-embed probe from CI: p95 down to 0.48s, error_rate ~0.6%. recovery looks good. :thumbsup:

Ryan: opening INC-4521 with logs and runbook. assigning Jordan for triage and Derek for rollback/hotfix plan. tagging SupportOps and Product.

Jordan: triaging now. checking autoscaler and kernel selection diffs; reproducing failing pod image locally.

Derek: adding postmortem action: make canary subset assignment deterministic across AZs; affected subset was 3/10 and infra-skewed.

Sam: next steps: 1) keep eu1 pinned until fix/hotfix, 2) replicate failing pod locally, 3) if fix is routing revert, cut v2.14.1 and smoke in staging then roll, 4) update internal release notes with incident and mitigation.

Maria: updating internal release notes draft and linking INC-4521.

Ryan: notifying Product and Support: EU embed pinned to previous version; customers may see transient errors. @SupportOps please monitor.

SupportOps: acknowledged, will watch queues and escalate if needed.

Sam: holding rollout and moving to triage channel. will escalate if we see cross-region impact. :white_check_mark:
